name: Troilus Mining Corp.
summary: Troilus Mining Corp. engages in exploration and development of mineral properties in Canada. The company explores for gold, silver, and copper deposits. Its flagship property is the 100% owned Troilus Gold project that covers an area of approximately 435 square kilometers located northeast of the Val-d'Or mining district, within the Frotêt-Evans Greenstone Belt in Quebec, Canada. The company was formerly known as Troilus Gold Corp. and change its name to Troilus Mining Corp. in December 2025. Troilus Mining Corp. is headquartered in Montreal, Canada.
